analysis:
The only changed line in this file is line 312, outside the supplied units. Per the patch excerpt it changes `case .toolCall:` to `case .toolCall, .toolCallDelta:` in a test helper (recordServerStream) that skips tool-call events. This is test-only code; no production authorization, attestation, encryption or billing logic is touched.

I examined the supplied head-side ranges (lines 655-1818): KV re-slice grant tests, the fixed-reference paged pool clamp diagnostics, the reslice floor refusal, the regrow gate race test, the heartbeat budget test and the request-routing tests. These are unchanged context and test assertions. They touch cacheScope plumbing (line 1727 asserts the tenant scope is passed through as cacheSalt, which fits T-041's coordinator-authored salt) and tool_choice validation, with no apparent change to security behavior.

The new `.toolCallDelta` event case is introduced elsewhere in the PR, in source files not supplied here. Whether the production streaming path validates forced tool_choice (the "forced tool_choice produced visible text before a validated call" check at lines 1409 and 1586) correctly for delta events cannot be determined from this file. The test helper silently ignores delta events, so test coverage might not observe leakage of unvalidated tool-call deltas. The integration pass should check the production code that emits `.toolCallDelta` and confirm that forced and named tool_choice validation and fail-closed behavior still hold before deltas are exposed. No finding qualifies from the supplied evidence.
